Four friends die in UP road accident; three killed in MP collision

In Uttar Pradesh, four friends returning from Moradabad to Sitapur died in a severe road accident on Monday evening in Rampur when their Bolero fell off a flyover. In a separate incident in Madhya Pradesh, a collision between a pickup vehicle and a motorcycle in Dhar resulted in the deaths of four people, including three girls.
